en: The postcard depicts a public square or park with a prominent large statue at its center. The statue shows a standing figure pointing forward, elevated on a tall pedestal adorned with additional sculptural elements. In the foreground, there is a circular flower bed with vibrant red flowers and lush foliage, benches, and manicured lawns. The backdrop includes dense trees, a mountain, and some historical-looking towers or buildings. A fountain can also be seen to the right side.
